[[:File:Bound Vizu.jpg|View image with boss aura]] | type = Shiro'ken | affiliation = Shiro's army | profession = a | level = 24 | boss = y | campaign = Factions | map1 = [[File:Tahnnakai Temple map.jpg|150px]] | map1-text = Location in [[Tahnnakai Temple]] }} [[Bound Vizu]], the final Construct boss encountered in the [[Tahnnakai Temple]] mission, is the bound spirit of the ancient [[Cantha]]n hero, [[Vizu]]. ==Missions== *[[Kaineng City]] **{{NPC location|Tahnnakai Temple}} ==Skills== (16 [[Dagger Mastery]], 20 [[Deadly Arts]] in [[Hard mode]]) *{{skill icon|Disrupting Stab}} *{{skill icon|Shadow Refuge}} *{{skill icon|Shroud of Silence}} ([[elite]]) *{{skill icon|Twisting Fangs}} *{{skill icon|Wild Strike}} ==Items dropped== *[[Soul Stone]] ==Notes== *To capture [[Shroud of Silence]], Bound Vizu will need to be killed before the rest of the [[Afflicted]] on the center platform as slaying all of them triggers a cutscene and ends the mission.
